title: Proving his two-beat bass to symphony bassists
summary: A symphony bassist doubts Foster's rhythm, and Foster offers to prove it with a piano player; he says he took the rhythm from a pianist's left hand.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique
